Name: Coal Point Farm - Custom NPCs
Author: AndrewJamesC
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000][size=4][center]﻿PRE INSTALLATION WARNING: [u]DO NOT INSTALL MID-SAVE FROM FALL 1 TO FALL 20![/u] YOU WILL HAVE A BROKEN ORDER OF EVENTS! [/center][/size][/color][/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/E0DdQV6.png[/img]
[center][color=#b45f06][size=4][b]
Welcome to Coal Point Farm![/b][/size][/color][/center]
At Coal Point Farm, you'll meet 3 (And a half!) wonderful NPCs and explore how they navigate the farm with an incoming baby and absent patriarch. Introducing...

[b][color=#20124d][u]❤️Mora[/u][/color]: [/b][size=2]Mora is a young woman who moved to her Aunt Ashida and Uncle Isaac's farm with her best friend, Marcus, a few years ago from Zuzu City. While she used to feel a sense of peace at Coal Point, she's slowly isolated herself, relying only on her friendship with Marcus and relationship with her aunt. Can you help her sort our her social anxiety, or will she stay shut off forever?

[/size][color=#cfe2f3][u]❤️[b]Marcus[/b][/u][/color][size=3]:[/size][size=2][b] [/b]Marcus is a young man who moved to Coal Point with his best friend Mora after not being sure what to do after graduating highschool. He prides himself in his abilities to make friends and prowess as the strongest man in the valley, often letting it get to his head. It's put a strain on his friendship with Mora, leaving the whole farm tense. Can you help to sort out the difference of opinion faced by the farm, or will his cockiness continue to ail the farm?
[/size][size=2]
[/size][color=#cc4125][u][b]Ashida[/b][/u][/color][size=3]: [/size][size=2]Ashida is a woman who grew up in the Gotoran Republic, moving to her husband Isaac's family farm after they married. After her niece and her best friend graduated highschool, she employed them on the farm, and the 4 were a happy family- until Isaac was called back into service in the Gotoran War. With his baby on the way but no Isaac, as well as an entire farm (And mangy 20-somethings) to manage, can Ashida lead the farm in absence of Isaac, or will it fall like your grandfather's before?
[/size][size=2]
[/size][b][color=#6aa84f][u]Isaac I[/u][/color][/b][size=3]: [/size][size=2]Isaac I is a man who currently serves in the army of the Ferngill Republic, proving himself as an esteemed soldier and in high-demand of the army. But with his power, comes the need to be away from his newly pregnant wife Ashida and niece Mora. While the farm does manage without him, it leaves a strain, perhaps only fixed by his presence. Will his return be fruitful, or will the farm continue to stagnate, even after he's discharged? Isaac I will return late Spring, year 2. Befriending him should be easy, and will yield the benefit of Coal Point North.
[/size][size=2]
❤️ Denotes marriageable

[/size][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ajqD2Gc.png[/img]
